app.tagline: Clean books, numbers you can defend.

errors.pageBody: The error was logged. Try loading the page again.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role does not allow this page. Ask an Admin if you need it.

login.pitch: General ledger, receivables, payables, cash and bank, tax, fixed assets, budgets and financial statements in one system.
login.subtitle: Use the account your Admin created.
login.forgotHint: We'll email a reset link to your account address.
login.resetSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.

errors.captcha: Security check failed. Wait for the green check and try again.
errors.generic: Could not sign in. Try again in a moment.

descriptions.dashboard: Cash, receivables, payables and profit at a glance.
descriptions.approvals: Documents waiting for a second person.
descriptions.accounts: Account structure, cost centers and projects.
descriptions.journals: Manual entries, opening balances and recurring journals.
descriptions.ledger: Movements and running balance per account.
descriptions.periods: Open, close and lock accounting periods.
descriptions.invoices: Bill customers and issue credit notes.
descriptions.receipts: Record incoming payments and apply them to invoices.
descriptions.bills: Supplier bills, debit notes and withholding tax.
descriptions.payments: Pay suppliers and apply payments to bills.
descriptions.aging: Who owes how much, and since when.
descriptions.cash: Account balances, cash in/out, transfers and rates.
descriptions.reconcile: Match bank statements to the books.
descriptions.expenses: Submit and pay employee expense claims.
descriptions.tax: Input/output VAT, withholding tax and settlement.
descriptions.assets: Asset register, monthly depreciation and disposal.
descriptions.budgets: Plan budgets and compare them with actuals.
descriptions.reports: Balance sheet, income statement, cash flow and trial balance.
descriptions.settings: Company profile, account mapping and users.
descriptions.system: Demo data, reset and system logs.

notFound.body: This address does not exist in Sopi.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: Approval requests and document status updates show up here.

palette.placeholder: Search pages, documents, partners or actions...

password.rule: At least 8 characters with upper case, lower case and a number.
password.weak: Use at least 8 characters with upper case, lower case and a number.
password.demoLocked: Demo accounts are shared, so their password cannot be changed.
password.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used.
password.codeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired.

pending.title: Waiting for access
pending.body: {email} is active, but an Admin has not given it a role yet. Ask your Admin, then check again.

email.rule: A confirmation link is sent to the new address (and the old one). The new email applies once the link is opened.
email.demoLocked: The demo account is shared, so its email cannot be changed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Name, email, language, theme and password

shell.signOutBody: You will need to sign in again to continue.

serverErrors.DUPLICATE: This code or record already exists.
serverErrors.IN_USE: This record is still used elsewhere.
serverErrors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
serverErrors.INVALID_STATUS: The document status does not allow this.
serverErrors.SELF_APPROVAL: You cannot approve your own document.
serverErrors.DEMO_ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Demo accounts cannot change email or password.
serverErrors.ACCOUNT_CONTROL_INVALID: Only receivable/payable accounts can be control accounts.
serverErrors.ACCOUNT_HAS_ENTRIES: The account has entries; its type, subtype and currency are fixed.
serverErrors.ACCOUNT_MAP_MISSING: System account mapping is incomplete (Settings → Account mapping).
serverErrors.ACCOUNT_NOT_POSTABLE: A line uses a header or inactive account.
serverErrors.ACCOUNT_PARENT_INVALID: The parent must be a header account of the same type.
serverErrors.CONTROL_ACCOUNT: Control and cash accounts cannot be used here; use receivables, payables or cash.
serverErrors.JOURNAL_EMPTY: A journal needs at least two lines with amounts.
serverErrors.JOURNAL_UNBALANCED: Debits and credits do not match.
serverErrors.JOURNAL_LOCKED: Posted journals cannot change. Post a reversal.
serverErrors.JOURNAL_FROM_SUBLEDGER: This journal belongs to a document; void the document instead.
serverErrors.REVERSAL_BEFORE_ORIGINAL: A reversal cannot be dated before the original.
serverErrors.PERIOD_CLOSED: The period for this date is closed.
serverErrors.PERIOD_MISSING: No accounting period covers this date.
serverErrors.PERIOD_HAS_PENDING: Documents in this period still wait for approval.
serverErrors.PERIOD_STILL_OPEN: Close every period of the year first.
serverErrors.LATER_YEAR_CLOSED: A later fiscal year is closed.
serverErrors.INVOICE_EMPTY: The document has no lines with amounts.
serverErrors.INVOICE_HAS_PAYMENTS: The document has payments or applications; void those first.
serverErrors.EXCEEDS_OPEN: The amount exceeds the open balance.
serverErrors.ALLOCATION_INVALID: Allocate only to open documents of the same partner and currency.
serverErrors.NOTE_TARGET_INVALID: A note must target an invoice/bill of the same partner and currency.
serverErrors.PARTNER_INVALID: The partner is inactive or not a matching customer/supplier.
serverErrors.LINE_NEGATIVE: A discount cannot exceed the line amount.
serverErrors.TAX_KIND_INVALID: Wrong tax type for this field.
serverErrors.WHT_SALES_AT_PAYMENT: Tax withheld by a customer is recorded on the receipt, not the invoice.
serverErrors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The bank account currency does not match.
serverErrors.TRANSFER_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Same-currency transfers must move the same amount.
serverErrors.RECONCILED: The entry is reconciled; reopen the reconciliation first.
serverErrors.MATCH_INVALID: Statement and book amounts do not match.
serverErrors.STATEMENT_UNBALANCED: Opening balance plus lines does not equal the closing balance.
serverErrors.EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_INVALID: Claims can only use expense accounts.
serverErrors.NOTHING_TO_SETTLE: There is no VAT balance to settle.
serverErrors.VAT_ALREADY_SETTLED: VAT for this period is already settled.
serverErrors.FX_REVAL_EXISTS: An FX revaluation already exists for this date.
